broker: RabbitMQ4.1.4 isolated fixture without host ports
connector: Official RMQSource/RMQSink 3.0.1-1.17 with managed DynamicTable adapter; observed target-version compatibility only
authorization: Compile checks task-approved database binding, direction-specific queue ACL and approved credentialRef.
Worker secret file separately verifies host/port/vhost/queue/SSL before creating connection.
Queue passive inspection only; source requires checkpointing, sink uses persistent mandatory messages and broker confirms.
limits: Direct official Flink CLI acceptance; no management API or DS scheduled instance is claimed.
Flink continuous JSON messages only; top-level fields, ISO dates, exact declared numeric bounds; message budget1MiB.
Input checkpoint acknowledgements and confirmed output can still duplicate across system recovery; no transactional exactly-once claim.
